canonical_update_reason: a package coding wave never writes the canonical graph

feature_observations.observation: Registry operations had no runtime outside REST. Core now serves every registered operation by the handler its declaration names (OperationHandlerCatalog + CatalogOperationHandler), wraps transactional operations in its own ConnectionOperationTransactionBoundary, denies any required capability through UndeclaredCapabilityGate, and plane operations describe their change before making it, so a bulk node move can be proposed and approved.
